maintenance_led.reason: Sells chlor alkali, vinyls, epoxy materials and Winchester ammunition as new product sales, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private chemical, industrial and water-treatment firms plus consumers and retailers buying Winchester ammunition; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own chlor alkali, epoxy and ammunition operations, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Mostly commodity chlor alkali, caustic soda and vinyls bought on price, so customers can switch suppliers fairly easily.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call: some epoxy and specialty products are hard to replace, but most revenue is commodity chemicals.
